profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cisco
profile.summary:
	IT professional with 10+ years of experience in Information Technology Industry that includes Information Security, Network Security and Log Management Tools implementation and Administration.
	Over 5 years of Strong experience in log management tools like Qradar and Arcsight.
	Experience in ArcSight ESM and ArcSight Logger, NetWitness, SourceFire, Footprints.
	Good experience working with System Center Configuration Manager and System administration of UNIX®, Windows®, or Linux®. 
	Strong experience in IT infrastructure such as LANs, WANs, VPNs, Nortel/Juniper Switches, Nortel/Juniper Routers, Check Point Firewalls, TCP/IP, Remote Access.
	Experience Active Directory Using ADMT Single sign-on with advanced authentication.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Position Accountabilities

 

1.            Performs ongoing network maintenance, diagnostics, administration, and design for 1,000+ nodes in multiple on-premises and cloud environments.

2.            Troubleshoot network related issues.

3.            Work with ACS support staff to provide prompt resolution of staff network problems and requests

4.            Administers DNS/DHCP services.

5.            Administers Next Generation Firewalls (on-premises and Cloud) and VPN firewall appliances.

6.            Collaborates with Cloud Operations, Windows, Storage, Linux and application development teams to determine their network needs.

7.            Works with security teams to ensure that all network components are secure and PCI compliant.

8.            Administers switches, routers, ADC’s and NAC.

9.            Works with ISPs to ensure reliable Internet connectivity and performance.

10.          Services will be required outside of core working hours. Minimum travel may be required.

positions.title: Senior Network Security Engineer
positions.description:
Lead and coordinate the Incident Response process for incident impact assessments, incident remediation planning, vulnerability and threat research intelligence, response management and recovery response management.
Provide technical security guidance on all security systems and their corresponding or associated software, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, cryptography systems, and anti-virus software. 
Technical liaison with 3rd party vendor for Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and SOC provider.
Ensure the SIEM tool/process is working properly.
Provide on-call support for all in-place security solutions.
Develop and maintain KPI for Security processes and activities.
Manage the Vulnerability Management process/tool.
Establish/maintain baselines and security configurations and tools of all IT devices,
Participate in investigations into suspicious activity.
Assist in documentation and enforcement of policies, procedures, and associated plans for system security administration and user system access based on industry-standard best practices.
Review server logs, firewall logs, intrusion detection logs, and network traffic for unusual or suspicious activity. Interpret activity and make recommendations for resolution.
Research emerging security threats, products, services, protocols, and standards.
Research/recommend additional security solutions or enhancements to existing security solutions to improve overall enterprise security.

positions.title: IT Security Lead
positions.description:
•	Collaborate with the customer Cyber Security leadership to meet evolving security needs related to existing or anticipated breaches. 

•	Review, analyze and troubleshoot technical issues. 
•	Work on complex / escalated incidents, problems and changes.
•	Manage, lead and prioritise a team of Security Analysts , provide level 3 support and own achieving SLAs for agreed service metrics.
•	Provide leadership and training to technical support staff including mentoring of 2nd line support staff to improve diagnostic skills and encouraging them to achieve security product accreditation.
•	Carry out Security Solutions Technical Consultancy and implementation in support of customer project work.
•	Produce scripts and supporting documentation to allow the 2nd line diagnostic team to undertake remote software downloads configuration changes and implementation of new customer projects.
•	Attend meetings on behalf of the team and line manager.

positions.title: Security Engineer
positions.description:
Work with IT team on the investigation and remediation of security events.
·         Hands-on experience in deploying, configuring and supporting/troubleshooting Cisco or other network devices: Switches, routers, firewalls and security appliances.
·         Perform event and trend analysis to identify potential threats and security issues.
·         Develop information security policies, procedures, standards and guidelines based on knowledge of best practice and compliance requirements.
·         Conduct internal security reviews and coordinate remediation plans.
·         Hands-on technical knowledge of network operating systems, including Cisco IOS.
·         Knowledge and management of current network hardware, protocols, and Internet standards, including TCP/IP, UDP, IPV4/IPV6, VoIP, QOS, EIGRP, OSPF and Cisco ASA or Palo Alto firewalls.
·         Interests in LAN, WAN, WLAN, and WWAN design and implementation

positions.title: IT Security Analyst II
positions.description:
Responsibilities
	Manage & Maintain SOC operations. Analyze the information security compliance requirement (including statutory and regulatory requirements) and its status level. Provide consulting services on matters related to Information security control and business continuity requirements. Perform Security monitoring and log analysis Manage McAfee EPO, antivirus and encryption policies   Required Tech Skills: Alert Dashboard Monitoring
	Monitor Log availability 
	Security Events Monitoring  and 1st Level Response for incident response with experience in envision SIEM
	Log Data Retrieval & Log Source Integration from/with SIEM
	Monitoring & ensuring availability of IPS/IDS & SIEM Tools
	McAfee Endpoint Protection & Microsoft EFP Management
	Ensuring response to Anti-Spam & Antivirus Alerts
	Critical Security Incident response
	SPOC for operations support
	Creation and presentation of SLA reports
	Experience on Firewall, IPS & Vulnerability management
	Experience on web content filtering, email gateway & File Integrity Monitoring.
	Experience on L1 troubleshooting of Certificate, Access Management and Single Sign On.

positions.title: Security Analyst
positions.description:
Responsibilities 
	Using Altiris Helpdesk Solutions Ver. 6.0 SP5, Dell SecureWorks, Intuit Quickbase. Log Rhythm
	Qualys Vulnerability Management. 
	Identify security issues for remediation, creates, modifies, and updates Security Information event Management (SIEM) tool rules.
	Planning and implementing security measures to protect computer systems, networks and data. 
	Stay up-to-date on the latest intelligence, including hackers’ methodologies, in order to anticipate security breaches.
	Responsible for preventing data loss and service interruptions by researching new technologies that will effectively protect a network.

positions.title: Information Security Analyst
positions.description:
Responsibilities
	Identify security issues for remediation, creates, modifies, and updates Security Information event Management (SIEM) tool rules.
	Use Nessus Tenable Network Security and Dell Works, McAfee SIEM Products.
	Planning and implementing security measures to protect computer systems, networks and data. 
	Stay up-to-date on the latest intelligence, including hackers’ methodologies, in order to anticipate security breaches.
	Responsible for preventing data loss and service interruptions by researching new technologies that will effectively protect a network.

positions.title: IT Security Consultant
positions.description:
Responsibilities
	Regularly conducted change management processes for software and patch updates on ArcSight.
	Developed and communicated standard solutions with an in-depth knowledge of the current threat landscape including Advanced Persistent Threats, Distributed Denial of Service attacks, and Hactivism. 
	Worked with Mobile Application, Mobile Development, Mobile device/application testing, F5 BIG-IP Load Traffic Manager (LTM), McAfee SIEM Products.
	Developed security solutions within an IT SOC Services model. 
	Developed and maintained information security standards, and guidelines according to best practices, a changing threat landscape, and according to regulatory bodies. 
	Provided Server and Storage security design and consulting for a broad range of larger scale IT projects. 
	Possessed technical & security expertise across a broad set of server and storage technologies. 
	Demonstrated an understanding of current security trends and best practices. 
	Evaluated and analyzed white papers, technical documentation, detailed specifications. 
	Collaborated with Architecture, Security, TCOM, Network, Midrange, and Desktop resources to provide secure solutions. 
	Provided excellent communication skills, and interact at all levels within the organization.

positions.title: SOC Analyst.
positions.description:
Responsibilities
	Built and managed security information and event managers (SIEM), preferably ArcSight. 
	Monitored real time security events and proactively research to identify emerging threats. 
	Maintained enterprise-wide information security program efforts to identify and evaluate all critical systems. 
	Provided analysis, recognition and escalation of security events for remediation and further investigation. 
	Collaborated with external auditors to conduct in-depth compliance audits and present results to senior management. 
	Utilized intrusion detection and prevention software tools such as SourceFire as well as reading, writing and interpreting rules for SNORT.

positions.title: Network Operations
positions.description:
Responsibilities
	Responsible for design and implementation of centralized IBM Qradar SIEM for High Availability and Redundancy.
	Worked with ES40, ES20, 4100, 2100 and 1000 Alpha Servers running VMS System 7.3. Windows NT/2000/2003 server operator and domain administrator.
	Monitored 24x7 Network Operations Control for Wawa Corporate Data Center. 
	Responsible for Compaq Digital VMS process monitoring system, backups and restores, account creation/modification, print queues maintenance and process monitoring. 
	Responsible for monitoring applications, user accounts, server performance, and Active Directory implementation. 
	Monitoring over 550 stores network hardware and IP based ASYNC in addition to Frame relay communications to corporate office. 
	Involved in First line network hardware troubleshooting and Frame relay point of contact with Verizon and New Edge networks. 
	Monitored RemoteWare Xcellent 3.x and 4.x, store communication software. 
	Utilized Aprisma SpectroGRAPH (Formerly Cabletron Spectrum Enterprise). 
	Responsible for IBM AS/400 process monitoring, troubleshooting and backups. 
	Created and utilized Standard Operating Procedures and training materials utilized by all OCC personnel, as well as training of new OCC technicians.
